title: Car Delivery 1
briefing:
Dieter: Collect the car at dispatch and deliver it to the docks within 110 seconds.
Follow the marked route across the pad to the handover and finish gates. The pad stands in for Côte d’Azur; police, traffic and vehicle damage are not simulated.

medals.method: ceil(measured scripted seconds * 1.05 / 1.25 / 1.50) for gold / silver / bronze; source time remains the limit
medals.run: Godot 4.7.2, headless fixed 60 Hz, tests/mission_ladder_test.gd, fresh pad Boxster, shipped input_script, 2026-09-28

provenance.adaptation: Ordered delivery_pickup at dispatch, two route gates, delivery_return as dock handover, separate timed_finish; crossing only, no stopping, cargo, police or damage verdict.
